target_meaning.depth: sensor camera axial depth in mm, tactile/{side}_gsmini/depth, [240,320]
target_meaning.marker: current minus frame-local paired reference pixel coordinates, marker[1]-marker[0], [1200,2]; shared visibility selection and repeat-last padding

loss: sum of mean squared errors in train-statistic normalized coordinates
normalization: fixed train-only mean/std; statistics frame stride 10; all pixels/markers and both sensors
initialization: random ResNet18; shared trunk initialization saved for B0
checkpoint_selection: minimum full validation P0 loss after each epoch
